name: Culinaromancer
overview: The Culinaromancer uses melee and magic, and has a low combat level of 75. He essentially has no defence but should not be underestimated despite his low combat level, due to his magic attack having a flat 1 in 3 chance of hitting the player successfully and a max hit of 25.

If you are a low level and want to avoid damage, you can run away from him and attack with ranged or magic; this way he won't be able to hit you if you keep your distance, although it is advised to bring a few energy potions.
Another approach is to use freezing spells such as Ice spells or Entangle on him and attacking him with ranged or magic. This same method works also for stunning him.
Note: The player cannot use Prayer in this boss fight or any other Recipe for Disaster boss fight.
